recent.text: Poeltl’s first 4 games: 2.8 points, 4.5 rebounds, 1.0 stock, 57% on 1.8 FGA Last 4: 14.3 points, 8.8 rebounds, 2.5 stocks, 66% on 10.3 FGA
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: Both Poeltl & the Raps have acknowledged there are going to be nights where the back is acting up & he just doesn't have it. Fortunately, those nights have been few & far between recently. When he's right, Jak remains super valuable. Nobody else on the roster can do what he does

recent.text: And now look at him move his feet, get back in transition and strip Grant at the rim! 👍
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: A good indication of how active/mobile Poeltl's looked lately: He had 5 stocks (3 steals, 2 blocks) over his first 6 games. Over the last 2 games, he's recorded 8 stocks (4 steals, 4 blocks) and counting. Like a completely different player than we saw earlier in the season.

recent.text: Battle's hit his last 5 3-point attempts, including 4 in the 3rd quarter. He shot a perfect 5-for-5 from the field and had 14 of his 18 points in the Q. Yesterday, he told us Klay Thompson is one of the shooters/players that he studies, and that was a very Klay-like quarter
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: Was watching Jamison Battle shoot 3s after Raptors practice yesterday. At one point, he casually hit 13 in a row. Well, he's knocked down his last 4 attempts tonight, and after trailing by as many as 16 points in this quarter, the Raptors are back within 4.

recent.text: Barrett in the 3rd quarter: 10 points, 4-8 FG (4-5 inside the arc), 2-3 FT, 2 rebounds, 2 assists. A big part of the push to get back into this game. Better. Much better.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: Barrett is getting the star treatment from the Grizzlies D, without Kawhi/Barnes/IQ on the floor. Might explain the 2-for-8 shooting (uncharacteristic), but no good excuse (that I'm aware of) for missing 4 of 6 free throws. Just 1 rebound and no assists in 17 minutes. Need more!
